# Neon Postgres (Neon)

Neon's guide to connections, branching, migrations, autoscaling and search on Neon Postgres.

- Source: https://github.com/neondatabase/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase/agent-skills/main/skills/neon-postgres/SKILL.md
- Author: Neon
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/neon-postgres-neon-f6090d75

For work against an existing Neon database. It covers pooled versus direct connections, schema migrations, database branching, autoscaling and scale-to-zero, instant restore, read replicas, IP allow lists, logical replication, and full-text, vector and hybrid search. New backend setup, auth and functions go to the parent neon skill. References are bundled.

**Try asking:**
- "Set up a Neon branch for each preview deployment"
- "Should I use the pooled connection string here?"
- "Add vector search to my Neon database"
